remarks.role: vercel CEO
remarks.text:
https://t.co/OL0LzGtvAw is 6.3mb. It starts up in 10µs¹. It's a Zig-compiled static ELF binary, or an even smaller 𝚕𝚒𝚋𝚏𝚡.𝚠𝚊𝚜𝚖² 

AI will make most infrastructure natively optimized. Case in point: fx can literally finish tasks faster than other agents can boot.

Fast is a one-way street.

¹ that's microseconds
² fun fact: the wasm build is actually *smaller*. A lot of binary weight comes from the TLS/HTTP stack. In WebAssembly, fx delegates 𝚏𝚎𝚝𝚌𝚑() to the JS runtime instead. You can try this on https://t.co/me7se5dvip
remarks.translation: https://t.co/OL0LzGtvAw 大小为6.3MB。它能在10微秒¹内启动。这是一个用Zig编译的静态ELF二进制文件，或者更小的𝚕𝚒𝚋𝚏𝚡.𝚠𝚊𝚜𝚖²。AI将使大多数基础设施实现原生优化。一个例子是：fx实际上能比其他代理启动更快地完成任务。快速是一条单行道。¹ 那是微秒 ² 有趣的事实：wasm构建实际上*更小*。大量二进制重量来自TLS/HTTP栈。在WebAssembly中，fx将𝚏𝚎𝚝𝚌𝚑()委托给JS运行时。你可以在https://t.co/me7se5dvip上尝试。

remarks.name: Madhu Guru
remarks.role: Sr Director, AI at Meta; Prev: Google - Led Gemini, Veo, Nano Banana.
remarks.text:
The best way to get good at evals - Part 3. 

Let’s talk failure modes taxonomy - that’s the first thing you should build once you have v1 of your evals.

Start with your production traces - study the last 500 or 1,000 interactions and look at the failures. Cluster them and name the clusters.

Get specific - “bad answer” isn’t a useful cluster name. 

Specific failures - wrong document retrieved / right document but irrelevant section / failed to ground to context and hallucinated /  failed to punt on answer and instead made stuff up / question ambiguous  and made poor assumptions rather than asking clarifying questions etc.

Those are very different problems.

Once you can name the failure precisely, you can build eval tests specifically designed to catch it.

You now have the bridge from evals to an improvement flywheel. More tomorrow…
remarks.translation: 做好评估的最佳方法——第3部分。我们来谈谈失败模式分类法——这是你一旦有了评估v1版本后应该首先构建的东西。从你的生产轨迹开始——研究最近500或1000次交互，并查看失败之处。将它们聚类并给聚类命名。要具体——“糟糕的回答”不是一个有用的聚类名称。具体的失败——检索到了错误的文档/文档正确但段落无关/未能基于上下文进行落地并产生了幻觉/未能对答案表示无法回答，反而编造了内容/问题含糊不清，并且做出了糟糕的假设，而不是提出澄清性问题等。这些是非常不同的问题。一旦你能准确命名失败，你就能构建专门用于捕捉它的评估测试。你现在就有了从评估到改进飞轮的桥梁。明天继续……

remarks.name: Thibault Sottiaux
remarks.role: Codex & ChatGPT OpenAI
remarks.text:
Today we’re previewing Private Safety Processing, designed to let us keep offering Zero Data Retention while improving our safeguards. Even when benefiting from frontier intelligence, customers shouldn’t have to give up control of sensitive data.

For ZDR deployments, content stays on infrastructure the customer controls. Automated systems look for patterns across related interactions and return limited safety signals, without exposing the underlying prompts or responses to OpenAI employees (even me!).

We’re also developing an OpenAI-hosted option encrypted with customer-controlled keys. We’re testing this with early customers now and plan to begin rolling it out in September.
remarks.translation: 今天，我们预览了“私密安全处理”功能，旨在让我们在继续提供“零数据保留”的同时改进安全防护。即使受益于前沿智能，客户也不应被迫放弃对敏感数据的控制。对于ZDR部署，内容保留在客户控制的基础设施上。自动化系统会跨相关交互查找模式，并返回有限的安全信号，而不会将底层提示或响应暴露给OpenAI员工（甚至包括我！）。我们还在开发一种由OpenAI托管、使用客户控制密钥加密的选项。我们目前正在与早期客户进行测试，并计划于九月开始逐步推出。
